title: FBI-UAP-D003, Digital Rendering, Unresolved UAP Report, Colorado Springs, 2022
what_is_it: A digitally rendered artistic interpretation of a reported UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena) incident, based on a first-hand witness narrative.
interpretation_warnings: No text was extractable from the PDF; all facts are derived from file metadata and the war.gov CSV description only.
This is an artistic interpretation, not photographic or sensor evidence of a UAP.
The rendering is based on a single witness narrative from a companion document (FBI-UAP-D002), making it a second-order representation of a single-source account.
The underlying case is marked unresolved, meaning no determination was made about the nature of the reported phenomena.

verifiable_claims.claim: The image is an artistic interpretation, not a direct photograph or sensor capture of the reported UAP.
The underlying UAP report remains unresolved.
